forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: ff8b80
+title: 'mirdan install tests: add plugin MCP-preservation and skill lifecycle unit tests'
+---
+Two test-coverage findings from the ^t1y1c37 review of `crates/mirdan/src/install/tests.rs`. Both are pre-existing gaps: the tests moved verbatim in the install.rs split, and the missing coverage predates it.
+
+## Items
+
+- Add `test_deploy_plugin_preserves_existing_mcp_servers`, mirroring `test_deploy_tool_preserves_existing_mcp_servers`: pre-populate `.mcp.json` with an existing server, deploy a plugin with a bundled `.mcp.json`, verify both servers are present, and verify that uninstalling the plugin leaves the original server intact.
+- Skills lack the unit-test trio that tools, plugins, and validators each have. Add `test_deploy_skill_creates_files`, `test_deploy_and_uninstall_skill`, and `test_uninstall_skill_not_found`. Note: `uninstall_skill` now returns `NotFound` when neither symlinks nor store entries exist — the third test asserts that error.
+
+## Acceptance
+
+- The new tests pass in `cargo nextest run -p mirdan`.
+- `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean. #test-coverage
\ No newline at end of file
